verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's own OpenFeature documentation page says switching to or from GrowthBook only changes the provider bootstrap, not any flag call, which directly addresses the vendor lock-in concern. However, the evidence is a single line, so the breadth and maturity of the provider support are unproven. Missing for 10: which languages or SDKs have OpenFeature providers, details of provider setup and feature parity (e.g., targeting context and hooks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API

citations.quote: Switching from or to GrowthBook only requires changing the provider bootstrap, not a single flag call.
